phase_prompt.label: The Legacy Keeper
phase_prompt.summary: Jared in his standard state, acting as the grounded, sorrowful father figure within the simulation's arid zones. He represents the stability of the old code before the system update.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body, low-angle shot of Jared, an ancient patriarch in a simulation, standing firm against a digital wind. His robes of matte obsidian-fabric whip around him, revealing boots that merge with the dusty ground. The lighting is severe, mimicking a single point-source sun, creating sharp, dramatic shadows (chiaroscuro). His expression is one of stoic grief. The environment is a barren, flat plane with a visible grid texture fading into the atmospheric haze. Rendered in 8k, photorealistic style with a focus on material textures and emotional weight.
